audit.whatIsWrong: Content claims you can 'interrupt' Pop Blossom with 'E Abscond displacement' — Sylas E is a dash/pull with no displacement or interrupt, and Neeko's R preparation carries no channel flag in the kit. Also widespread misgendering, a dosFull title referencing a silence Neeko does not have, no digits in cooldowns, and template trade strings.
audit.why: Kit authority: Neeko R is a 600-range leap (120/105/90s) with a short preparation — dodging, walking out, or stealing it are verifiable answers; a Sylas interrupt is not. Tangle-Barbs 12-10s grows through champions; W clone every 16-12s.
audit.corrected: Interrupt claims replaced with dodge/outrange/steal; pronouns fixed; cooldowns field now carries 12-10s and 120/105/90; trades grounded in the root-down window.
